title: Scenario 4: LSASS Credential Dumping
description: Attackers access the lsass.exe process to dump credentials from memory. This is a critical technique used by APT29 to escalate privileges and move laterally.
mitre_technique: T1003.001 - OS Credential Dumping: LSASS Memory
hunt_for: Look for processes accessing lsass.exe with full access rights (0x1FFFFF). This is highly suspicious unless performed by legitimate security tools.
detection_tips: Search for Sysmon Event ID 10 (Process Access)
